usedFor: Shopify holds the products, and Google Blogger receives a post through “Create Blog Post” after “New Product”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Blog Post” in Google Blogger
bestTemplate.why: A new product is news worth a post, and the action takes a title, content and labels.

watchOut: “Create Blog Post” takes a publish date as YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss UTC or RFC3339, so format any date you pass.
